headline: Approved 30-lot Woodlands Reserve subdivision off Parkside Drive; approved 1-year extension for UNE pier at 11 Hills Beach Road; recommended data center ban.
summary: Approved a 30-lot subdivision off Parkside Drive, a site plan amendment for 46-unit senior housing on Barra Road, and a shoreland permit at 41 Bridge Road. A 3-2 vote approved a 1-year extension for UNE's marine research pier at 11 Hills Beach Road. Recommended City Council adoption of a data center ban, a front yard setback reduction, and new mobile home park setbacks.
decisions: Approved the September 2, 2026 meeting minutes as presented; passed unanimously.
Approved a 1-year extension of the 2025 approval for the Marine Research Science Pier at 11 Hills Beach Road, 3-2.
Approved a conditional use permit for a 1-chair barber shop at 351 West Street; passed unanimously.
Approved a site plan amendment for a 46-unit low-income senior housing development on Barra Road; passed unanimously.
Approved a shoreland permit to replace a legally existing non-conforming home at 41 Bridge Road; passed unanimously.
Approved Subdivision Amendment #2 for Longboard View, a seven-lot subdivision at 781 Pool Street; passed unanimously.
Approved the final site and subdivision plan for the 30-lot Woodlands Reserve off Parkside Drive and 268 Pool Street, with a front yard setback reduction from 40 to 25 feet; passed unanimously.
Recommended City Council adoption of a definition of data centers that prohibits data centers within Biddeford; passed unanimously.
Recommended City Council approval of reducing the minimum front yard setback from forty (40) feet to twenty-five (25) feet in several residential zones; passed unanimously.
Recommended City Council adoption of amended setbacks for mobile home parks, with 10 feet from lot boundary lines; passed unanimously.
